query:
SELECT u.id
              FROM users u
             WHERE u.id IN (
                   SELECT gm.userid
                     FROM channels c
                     JOIN groupchannels gc ON gc.channelid = c.id
                     JOIN usergroups ug ON ug.id = gc.groupid
                     JOIN groupmembers gm ON gm.groupid = ug.id
                    WHERE c.id = $1
                      AND gc.deleteat = 0
                      AND ug.deleteat = 0
                      AND gm.deleteat = 0
                    GROUP BY gm.userid
             )
